subject: Function-address-identifier
notes: 'Function-prototype-name-1 shall be a function prototype specified in the REPOSITORY paragraph.' Resolved through DataBinder.UserFunctionNames - the REPOSITORY FUNCTION specifiers WITHOUT the INTRINSIC phrase - plus 8.4.6.6's other leg, 'the user-function-name of the containing function definition', so a self-referential function-pointer inside a function definition needs no repository entry. The SAME two legs the USAGE clause's TO phrase resolves, written once per operand kind. A word in neither leg is not silently accepted: it falls to SR1's identifier test and is refused COBOL1960.
